mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1%) compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20d return in low FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS < 1%) is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245) signals persistent inflation, leading to increased risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20d return in high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 245) is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising) and inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between interaction condition (FEDFUNDS change > 0 AND CPIAUCSL > 240) and 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20d return in interaction periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime defined by unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0) and negative employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0% in last month), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between recession regime condition and 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20d return in recession periods is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1300) indicates robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20d return in strong housing market periods (HOUST > 1300) is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20d return in high INDPRO periods (INDPRO > 100) is not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between UNRATE and 5d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 5d return in high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 4.6) is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 60d return in weak industrial production periods (INDPRO < 100) is not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
